lift_rules: Knee rule: every set ≤3/10 at the knee. Over 3 → stop that exercise and step back (higher box, −20% load or shorter range). Progress load OR depth (never both) only if every set was ≤2/10 and tomorrow's stairs score is at or below baseline. Score the knee, not thigh soreness.
Log every session: load × reps @ RPE, the knee's maximum during it, and tomorrow's stairs score. Record as Traditional Strength Training on the Watch.
RPE: 6 = 4 reps left · 7 = 3 left · 8 = 2 left · 9 = 1 left. No sets to failure except the cable crunch (1–2 left).
Add load when all sets hit the top of the rep range at or under the target RPE with knee ≤2/10: squat/RDL +10 lb (+5 if RPE right on target), bench +5 lb, calves +10%, DBs +5 lb/hand.
Soreness next day ≥4/10 → repeat the same loads next time. ≥6/10 or it changes your stride → skip legs next lift.
Never superset two exercises for the same muscle. Rest is timed — set a repeating timer.
